# Sample vault

Fixture vault for manual testing of Context Pack and for automated tests.
Open this folder as a vault in Obsidian.

Covers: nested folders, notes with and without frontmatter, frontmatter and inline tags
(including mixed case), wikilinks, one broken link (`[[Missing note]]`), one image embed
(`![[diagram.png]]`), one note embed (`![[Glossary]]`), a markdown image, and a run of blank lines.
